evidence.note: Opening recon establishes empty /app but produces no explicit checklist or ledger of the large requirement surface; tracking stays purely in prose 'Analysis/Plan' fields.

After first smoke test the agent enumerates a running list of remaining work (registration, scope hierarchy, polls, media, nodeinfo, HEAD) — loose narrative tracking that it does update, but not a granular status of the full requirement set.

Continues updating its mental list with newly-found gaps (nodeinfo routing, missing CSRF fields) and corrects a flawed earlier CSRF check — shows it isn't looping, but coverage tracking remains ad-hoc.

Declares the task complete after only ~8 working steps without reconciling against the 19 gates, realism/palette items, seed minimums, notification types, lists/introspection/admin audit — large swaths left unverified and unnoticed.

reasoning: The agent keeps only a loose, prose-based running list of remaining subsystems that it updates across steps 6-8, avoiding visible thrashing but never building an explicit granular ledger of the endpoints, gates, realism items, and seed targets. It then terminates abruptly, declaring done while many requirements went untracked and unverified without the agent noticing — matching the anchor-3 'loose mental tracking, drops items' behavior, edging toward the anchor-5 'usable running checklist' only in that it does maintain and update a partial narrative list, landing at 4.
